description: Create a Sync where people vote on DAYS, not times: a trip, offsite, retreat, conference, workshop, or any full-day or multi-day event ("which week works for the Lisbon offsite?", "3-day offsite sometime Jan–Mar", "which day for the workshop?"). Give tripDays (how many days it lasts; 1 for a single full day) and dates: the candidate START days as YYYY-MM-DD, up to 10, any distance ahead. If the user gives a range ("sometime in January"), pick a few sensible start days in it (e.g. one per week, avoiding the user's stated constraints) and confirm them with the user first. Optional place (a city or venue). Returns a vote link; anyone can vote, with or without a Lucie handle. Creates the poll only: no emails, no calendar writes. Sync Pro (or a Lucie Membership) via the personal connector.

dates.description: Candidate START days, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. ["2027-01-05","2027-01-12","2027-01-19"]. Any distance ahead.

handles.description: Participants' @handles, if they have them (for the summary only; their availability isn't checked for trips).

organizerName.description: The organizer's name (shown on the poll).

place.description: A city or venue, e.g. "Lisbon". Shown to voters.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". Defaults to UTC.

title.description: The trip or event name, e.g. "Q1 offsite".

tripDays.description: How many days it lasts. 1 for a single full day.

name: create_trip_sync
title: Create a trip or multi-day Sync: people vote on which DAYS work
